content_of_post_to_answer: Do you find that a room feels more private when the curtains are closed?
answer: Yes, but the feeling of privacy comes from more than just blocking a view. Closed curtains create a psychological boundary: they signal that the outside world is temporarily not part of your space. Interestingly, the room itself has not changed, yet your relationship with it has. Privacy is often less about actual isolation and more about having control over what can enter your awareness. A curtain does not just hide a room; it helps the mind declare, "this space is mine."
